report_identity.report_title: 二零二五年年報 / 遠航港口發展有限公司

business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides inland port loading, unloading and ancillary port services in Chizhou, China.

segments.name: Port services
segments.source: Annual report note 6 and note 7(a), pages 119-122

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly from bulk cargo and general cargo loading and handling services, container handling, and ancillary port services.
business_notes: All revenue in 2025 and 2024 came from providing port services in China.
2025 cargo throughput decreased 6.8% year over year and container throughput increased 9.0%.
